verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers only web-based filing procedures (trademarks, patents, designs, e-Soleau) and portal services. None of it documents a system-to-system channel such as system accounts, transmitter programs or batch providers, and none publishes an enrollment path. The only machine-facing item is a probe showing a keyless GET to data.inpi.fr returned HTTP 403; its note that access needs an account-issued token is an inference from that denial, not documentation of a transactional API or how to enroll.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published
